summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The MicroSectors Gold 3X Leveraged ETNs (SHNY) is an exchange-traded note that is based on the LBMA Gold Price index. The fund is an exchange-traded note that provides 3x daily leveraged exposure to the spot price of gold by tracking GLD, an ETF that physically holds gold bars. SHNY was launched on Feb 24, 2023 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
